policy.refresh: node refresh-sources.mjs --check reports drift; --apply re-derives the vendored snapshots. The scheduled workflow pushes only the refresh branch, asks for a pull request, and never pushes to the default branch.
policy.fail_closed: An upstream that returns 404 or 410, or whose declared licence string has changed, stops the refresh. The stale snapshot is kept and a maintainer resolves it by hand.
policy.identity: Releases reference the immutable snapshot committed here, never live upstream content. A refresh that moves ground truth changes benchmark identity and must be reviewed as such.
policy.notices: Required W3C attribution and modification statements live in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and are not rewritten by a refresh.

sources.title: WCAG 2.2 success criteria
sources.transform: Reduced to criterion number, name, level, principle and guideline placement, plus the versions each criterion appears in. Normative prose is not vendored. 4.1.1 Parsing is retained with in_2_2 false because it was removed in WCAG 2.2.

sources.title: W3C ACT Rules test-case catalogue
sources.transform: Vendored as published. Reducing it would discard the expected outcomes the corpus measures against.

sources.title: WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices Guide patterns
sources.transform: Nothing is vendored. The pattern fixtures are original work informed by APG guidance, so the only honest automated signal is that upstream moved and the fixtures it informed need review.
